shortDescription: Manage regkey license assignment on BIG-IPs from a BIG-IQ

options.name: device
options.description: When C(managed) is C(false), specifies the address, or hostname, where the BIG-IQ can reach the remote device to register. When C(managed) is C(true), specifies the managed device, or device UUID, that you want to register. If C(managed) is C(true), it is very important you do not have more than one device with the same name. BIG-IQ internally recognizes devices by their ID, and therefore, this module cannot guarantee the correct device will be registered. The device returned is the device that

options.name: device_password
options.description: The password of the C(device_username). When C(managed) is C(false), this parameter is required.

options.name: device_port
options.description: Specifies the port of the remote device to connect to. If this parameter is not specified, the default is C(443).

options.name: device_username
options.description: The username used to connect to the remote device. This username should be one that has sufficient privileges on the remote device to do licensing. Usually this is the C(Administrator) role. When C(managed) is C(false), this parameter is required.

options.name: key
options.description: The registration key you want to assign from the pool.

options.name: managed
options.description: Whether the specified device is a managed or un-managed device. When C(state) is C(present), this parameter is required.

options.name: pool
options.description: The registration key pool to use.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the device is assigned the specified license. When C(absent), ensures the license is revoked from the remote device and freed on the BIG-IQ.
